author: Flexterfi
quote: And people call this the "best game," even though it simply incorporates features that other games have been using for years—a fact that goes completely unrecognized. They label it "innovation," when in reality it’s just a hodgepodge of those existing elements, yet they try to market it as the greatest innovation of the century.

author: Flexterfi
quote: In my experience as a player—even if I didn't get to play it back when it first came out—the experience, excitement, and satisfaction I felt playing this game were on another level. Very few games have managed to get me so hooked that I’d spend long stretches of time playing, all while wanting to keep discovering what happens next in the story. Simply fantastic.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
